grades.main_gap: The refinement lemma (i) and (ii), which constitute the entire quantitative content of both bounds, is only referenced to an external file; no proof appears in the write-up.
grades.notes: The claiming-phase reduction to the alternating sum is correctly proven (exchange argument slightly terse but acceptable), the answer 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1) is correct for small n, and both strategies are cleanly reduced to the stated lemma. However, the lemma itself is the heart of both directions and is entirely unproven here, leaving the main work unjustified.
